assets.summary: A female staff member presents press-on nails in a brightly lit, pink-themed store. She showcases various colorful nail designs, emphasizing daily updates and affordability. The video alternates between wide shots of the store, medium shots of the staff, and close-ups of the nail products.

evidence.description: person_1 stands in front of shelves filled with press-on nails, wearing a light pink top with ruffled collar and white wide-leg pants. She speaks to the camera, introducing the store. The background features pink walls and shelves labeled 'NEW NIO' with Chinese text promoting nail products.

Close-up shots of hands holding various press-on nail packages. The nails are colorful and feature designs like stars, polka dots, and solid colors. Text overlays describe the '多巴胺系列' (Dopamine Series) and highlight that each set is '绚丽多彩' (vivid and colorful).

person_1 is shown holding a yellow shopping basket, walking through the store aisle. She points to the shelves while speaking. Another person is visible in the background, organizing products. Text overlays mention daily updates of '上百个款式' (hundreds of styles) and that they are '当下remai的款式' (currently popular styles).

person_1 stands in the center of the store aisle, facing the camera. She gestures with her hands while speaking. Text overlays state '30副起批' (minimum 30 sets for wholesale) and '感兴趣姐妹记得找我哟' (interested sisters, remember to find me). The store's pink shelves and lighting remain consistent in the background.
